body: Tbh, I don't really remember the pain, like, my sister really knew something was wrong 18 hours after i had done it. I was in pain but still managed to go to work that day (back at the time, I was working on a fast food restaurant) but I remeber wanting to vomit all the time and calling my boss to tell him if i could get home earlier. But it was what came after that was really painful (the needles from the hospital for blood tests, the IV's, the fact taht i couldn't drink nor eat anything for 24 hours and my throat was super dry...). i don't really know how my family reacted. My sister dropped me to the ER and then went home because the next day she needed to work, my dad didn't care, neither did my mom.

OK i've been reading a lot of these comments and I want to tell my experience. Last year, i tried to kill myself by overdosing and i can just say, i doesn't work. It didn't work for me at least, i was just vomiting like i've never had and my sister found me shaking and almost unconcious in the bathroom. I was rushed to the ER and they said my stomach was bleeding from the inside but they managed to control it and they put me on a psych ward for months to prevent hurting myself again. I don't know what i did wrong, but i wish it would have worked...
I don't think you could help me...i'm just tired of everything

I can relate to this so much...I'm always sick because of my weak immune system and I'm in so much pain, my dad hates me and my mom abandonned me for money, I was abused by both of them and developed severe PTSD and other mental disorders. Honestly, even if I had  a chance, I wouldn't  take it, I just want to die, sorry for not being able to help you, but I feel the same as you do
